strings.draw: No moves remain. Each player earns 150 points.
strings.ended: The host ended this match. Points already earned stay.
strings.hint: Exactly five wins. Six does not.
strings.swapHint: White may swap colours or place a stone.
strings.five: Exactly five stones in a row.
help: Black places the first stone. White goes next.
Exactly five stones in a row wins horizontally, vertically or diagonally. A longer line does not win.
With the swap rule on, White may swap colours after Black’s opening stone. The new White plays next.
The cross marks the last stone. Use the arrow keys and Enter to play with a keyboard.
